The defendant Yang operated a pharmacy/medicine department without drug production license, purchased raw herbs, repackaged and sold them, using false packaging and labels, possibly counterfeit drug packaging, violating drug administration law. Likely crimes: illegal manufacturing of medicinal products (非法生产、非法经营药品) and illegal sale of unlicensed drugs. In Chinese criminal law, relevant offenses: “非法生产、销售假药” (illegal production and sale of counterfeit drugs) or “非法经营药品” (illegal drug business). Since no license, and repackaging with false labels, could be “非法生产、销售药品” (illegal manufacturing and sale of drugs). Also possibly “非法经营药品” (illegal drug business). The facts: no drug production license, repackaged, used false packaging, sold. That is illegal manufacturing (production) of drug (since repackaging is considered processing). Under Criminal Law Article 141 (illegal manufacturing of special equipment?) Not. Actually Article 141: illegal manufacturing, sale of special equipment. Not relevant. Article 141? Let's recall: Criminal Law of PRC: Article 141 deals with illegal manufacturing of dangerous weapons. Not. Article 141 is about illegal manufacturing of special equipment. For drugs, Article 141? Not sure. Article 141 maybe about illegal manufacturing of controlled substances. But there is Article 141 for "非法生产、销售假药" (illegal production and sale of counterfeit drugs) under Article 141? Actually Article 141 of Criminal Law (1997) is about "非法生产、销售假药" (illegal production and sale of counterfeit drugs). The penalty: 3-7 years. Also Article 144: illegal business of medical devices. Article 144: "非法经营药品" (illegal drug business). Yes.

Thus charges: illegal production and sale of counterfeit drugs (假药) and illegal business of drugs (非法经营药品). The facts mention they used genuine ingredients? They purchased from market, but repackaged and labeled as from a company, maybe false labeling, but not necessarily counterfeit (假药). Could be "非法经营药品" (illegal drug business) because they lacked license. Also "非法生产药品" maybe "非法生产、销售药品" (without license). The typical charge: "非法经营药品罪". Also "非法生产、销售假药罪" if the drug is counterfeit. The description: they used packaging and labels of another company, maybe false. That could be considered counterfeit labeling, i.e., false drug packaging, which is illegal production of counterfeit drugs. So likely both.
